description: Source file implementing tensor type property functions and type promotion logic for PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: is_distributed
methods.description: Returns false indicating the tensor is not distributed.

methods.name: is_complex
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has a complex data type.

methods.name: is_floating_point
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has a floating point data type.

methods.name: is_inference
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is in inference mode.

methods.name: is_signed
methods.description: Checks if the tensor's data type is signed.

methods.name: _is_zerotensor
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a zero tensor.

methods.name: is_conj
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is conjugated.

methods.name: is_neg
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is negative.

methods.name: type_as
methods.description: Returns a tensor cast to the type of another tensor.

methods.name: result_type
methods.description: Determines the resulting data type from multiple tensors or scalars.

methods.name: can_cast
methods.description: Checks if casting from one scalar type to another is supported.

methods.name: promote_types
methods.description: Promotes two scalar types to a common type, with error checking.
